briefdescription.para: NumBuckets - Length of the Buckets array. Always a power of 2.
NumNodes - Number of nodes in the folding set.

detaileddescription.para: Growth occurs when NumNodes is greater than twice the number of buckets.

briefdescription.para: reserve - Increase the number of buckets such that adding the EltCount-th node won't cause a rebucket operation.

detaileddescription.para: reserve is permitted to allocate more space than requested by EltCount.

briefdescription.para: RemoveNode - Remove a node from the folding set, returning true if one was removed or false if the node was not in the folding set.
GetOrInsertNode - If there is an existing simple Node exactly equal to the specified node, return it.

detaileddescription.para: Otherwise, insert 'N' and return it instead.

briefdescription.para: FindNodeOrInsertPos - Look up the node specified by ID.

detaileddescription.para: If it exists, return it. If not, return the insertion token that will make insertion faster.

briefdescription.para: InsertNode - Insert the specified node into the folding set, knowing that it is not already in the folding set.

detaileddescription.para: InsertNode - Insert the specified node into the folding set, knowing that it is not already in the map.
InsertPos must be obtained from FindNodeOrInsertPos.

inbodydescription.para: The insert position is actually a bucket pointer.

briefdescription.para: clear - Remove all nodes from the folding set.
size - Returns the number of nodes in the folding set.
empty - Returns true if there are no nodes in the folding set.
capacity - Returns the number of nodes permitted in the folding set before a rebucket operation is performed.
GrowHashTable - Double the size of the hash table and rehash everything.
GrowBucketCount - resize the hash table and rehash everything.

detaileddescription.para: NewBucketCount must be a power of two, and must be greater than the old bucket count.

briefdescription.para: FoldingSetBase - Implements the folding set functionality.

detaileddescription.para: The main structure is an array of buckets. Each bucket is indexed by the hash of the nodes it contains. The bucket itself points to the nodes contained in the bucket via a singly linked list. The last node in the list points back to the bucket to facilitate node removal.
